items.quote: Christmas pudding is a sweet boiled or steamed pudding traditionally served as part of Christmas dinner in Britain.
items.note: Same article: 'may be dressed with warm brandy which is set alight' and 'It was common practice to include small silver coins in the pudding mixture'. The answer already allows plum pudding; suggest the host also accepts 'figgy pudding', which is what most rooms know from the carol.
